relations.text: NMIが10-Kで、競争の激しい民間住宅ローン保険の参加者として挙げる

source.quote: The private MI industry is highly competitive and currently consists of six approved participants, including us, Arch Capital Group Ltd., Essent Group Ltd. (Essent), Enact Holdings, Inc., MGIC Investment Corporation (MGIC), and Radian Group Inc. (Radian).
